children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Configure destinations with correct credentials, encryption, retention, health checks, and recurring restore validation.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: A destination is not operational until a scheduled isolated restore succeeds with emergency-access credentials.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: Document supported repository type, endpoint, TLS, permissions, immutability, lifecycle, and environment separation.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Publish limitations for S3-compatible and filesystem/PVC backends.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Record bucket/prefix, region, CA, path style, and required permissions.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Keep credentials and encryption material in labelled Secrets.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Define initialization, locks, checks, prune, retention, and rotation; live multi-volume copies are not consistent (v0.4.0).

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Monitor duration, bytes, count, growth, failures, missed runs, and locks.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Coordinate object lifecycle rules with application retention.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Alert on check/prune errors and credential or certificate expiry.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Restore representative worlds on schedule using the exact key and access procedure available during an emergency.

children.name: Quick Reference Line 1
children.text: 01  Supported backend + least-privilege Secret + TLS/CA + key

children.name: Quick Reference Line 2
children.text: 02  Alert on failed/missed backup, locks, checks, prune, growth, expiry

children.name: Quick Reference Line 3
children.text: 03  Accept only after scheduled isolated restore meets RPO/RTO
